purpose: Confirm the mechanism-selected MambaTSv3 candidate with AutoCon relation training enabled but prediction-connected representation fusion disabled, using the already completed same-source Electricity/Traffic H96 baseline artifacts.
research_question: Does the relation-auxiliary-only MambaTSv3 candidate remain competitive with the complete same-source high-dimensional baseline matrix when paired at the existing seeds?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only confirmation. Every new job skips the test loader; no test metric, prediction, streaming metric, or test release may be generated or inspected.
claim_boundary: A passing result supports a validation-only auxiliary-constraint architecture claim. It does not establish held-out accuracy, universal superiority, independent causal benefit across domains, or universal speed.

required_before_launch: verify Electricity and Traffic fingerprints and the complete 6-job expansion
freeze MambaTSv3 v3, AutoCon lambda, fusion-off setting, optimizer, normalization, budget, and paired seeds
keep skip_test=true and save_predictions=false for every job
use a fresh output root and retain the existing baseline roots as read-only comparison artifacts

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Candidate architecture, AutoCon lambda, baseline artifacts, data split, optimizer, scheduler, budget, and seeds are fixed before launch; no held-out signal or dataset-specific retuning is permitted.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: The new candidate uses the same chronological split, M features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, epochs, patience, and normalization as the existing high-dimensional baseline matrix.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: Only the new MambaTSv3AutoCon arm receives the frozen AutoCon objective; its prediction-connected representation fusion is explicitly disabled by the mechanism result.
capacity_fairness_contract.comparison_boundary: Existing DLinear, NLinear, RLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, iTransformer, and Mamba2 artifacts are read-only and must pass the same source and coordinate checks.

phases.name: relation_auxiliary_only_candidate_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Mechanism-selected MambaTSv3AutoCon candidate with relation objective enabled and prediction-connected fusion disabled.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: The dedicated strict reader may combine the six new candidate rows with the existing 42 baseline rows only after exact source, fingerprint, configuration, and coordinate checks.

stopping_rules: Do not promote a dataset to a held-out plan if the auxiliary-only candidate is more than 2% worse than its strongest registered baseline.
Do not infer a universal AutoCon causal contribution from this matrix.
Do not produce or inspect held-out artifacts.
prelaunch_gates: verify Electricity and Traffic fingerprints and the complete 6-job expansion
retain the existing baseline roots as immutable read-only comparison artifacts
keep skip_test=true and save_predictions=false for every new job
create one immutable source snapshot and fresh output root
